detail.longDescription: forgejo-mcp v3.4.0 is out 🚀 • a token Forgejo rejects now surfaces as a clear auth error • merge_pull_request tells you why a merge was refused • fork_repo no longer breaks on redirects • forgejo:// resources tell 404 from 403 by status code, not by digits in the URL (a test port of 40373 turned a 404 into "access denied" 🙃) • status resource reports the latest status per CI context https:// git.b4mad.industries/agentic-f orges/forgejo-mcp/releases/tag/v3.4.0 # Forgejo # MCP # AgenticAI
